title.en: Draw simple, multiple and component bar diagrams
Calculate angles for a pie diagram

say.en: Where does a family's money go each month? Cut a circle like a pizza and the biggest slice shouts the answer. In this lesson: Draw simple, multiple and component bar diagrams.
Calculate angles for a pie diagram.

body.en: *Bar diagrams* are one-dimensional: bars of equal width and equal gaps, whose heights show the values. A simple bar diagram shows one variable. A multiple bar diagram puts two or more bars side by side to compare. A component (sub-divided) bar diagram splits each bar into parts of the total.
body.kn: ಸ್ತಂಭ ಚಿತ್ರಗಳು ಏಕ-ಆಯಾಮದವು: ಸಮ ಅಗಲ, ಸಮ ಅಂತರ; ಎತ್ತರ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರಳ, ಬಹು ಮತ್ತು ಘಟಕ ಸ್ತಂಭ ಚಿತ್ರಗಳು ಇವೆ.

title.en: On the board: From rupees to bars and a pie

say.en: A family spends 12,000 rupees a month. Bars of equal width show each item by height.
A pie shows each item as a share of the whole circle of 360 degrees.
Food is half, so it gets 180 degrees. Rent is a quarter: 90 degrees.
Education 45, clothing 27, others 18. Together they make 360.

body.en: A *pie diagram* is a circle divided into sectors, each showing a component as a share of the total. The angle of a sector is the component divided by the total, times 360 degrees. The angles of all sectors add up to 360 degrees.
body.kn: ವೃತ್ತ ಚಿತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ವೃತ್ತವನ್ನು ವಲಯಗಳಾಗಿ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಕೋನ = ಘಟಕ ÷ ಒಟ್ಟು × 360°. ಎಲ್ಲ ಕೋನಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ 360°.

problem.en: A family spends ₹12,000: food ₹6,000, rent ₹3,000, education ₹1,500, clothing ₹900, others ₹600. Find the pie angles.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A family spends ₹12,000: food ₹6,000, rent ₹3,000, education ₹1,500, clothing ₹900, others ₹600. Find the pie angles.

say.en: Let us work this out together. A family spends 12,000 rupees: food 6,000, rupees rent 3,000, rupees education 1,500, rupees clothing 900, rupees others 600 rupees. Find the pie angles.
Food equals 6,000 over 12,000 times 360 degrees equals 180 degrees; Rent equals 3,000 over 12,000 times 360 degrees equals 90 degrees.
Education equals 1,500 over 12,000 times 360 degrees equals 45 degrees; Clothing equals 900 over 12,000 times 360 degrees equals 27 degrees.
Others equals 600 over 12,000 times 360 degrees equals 18 degrees.
Check: 180 plus 90 plus 45 plus 27 plus 18 equals 360 degrees.
So the answer is 180 degrees, 90 degrees, 45 degrees, 27 degrees, 18 degrees.

body.en: If the shares are already in per cent, just multiply each by 3.6 to get the angle. 25% × 3.6 = 90°, 10% × 3.6 = 36°.
